title: Two-Leg Listing Pairs
prompt:
Implement `find_split_pairs(listings, start_day, end_day) -> list[tuple[str, str]]`. `listings` maps each unique listing label to an iterable of integer days when that listing is available.

A valid result uses two distinct listings for two nonempty, adjacent portions of the inclusive trip window. For some integer split day `k` with `start_day <= k < end_day`, one listing must contain every day in `[start_day, k]` and the other must contain every day in `[k + 1, end_day]`. A listing may also be available on other days; assigned coverage is not required to be exact.

Return each unordered pair once, as a lexicographically ordered tuple, and sort the output lexicographically. If there is no valid pair, or the requested window has fewer than two days, return an empty list. Do not mutate the input availability collections.

example.reasoning: B covers the opening leg from day 4 through day 7, while C covers day 8 through day 10.
